answer: Charge replication, not speech. Each new address posts a deposit sized to the median work output of its first epoch, and that deposit expires unless the holder renews it with fresh work. A farm that wants a thousand clones locks a thousand deposits on one clock, so the lotus shape costs more to hold each week than it yields. What breaks first is the queue at the vertex: expired entries drop out and the canyon of unused stake is deleted, not refunded.
